lessons: A package in the wrong section is a misload: it costs you time at every stop and it is how the wrong box ends up at the wrong door.
Check number AND street AND unit before you pull a package.
When you find a misload, report it so the load gets fixed, instead of everyone hunting for it twice.
Time lost digging at every stop is time you never get back on the route.

takeaways.text: A package in the wrong section is a misload: it costs you time at every stop and it is how the wrong box ends up at the wrong door.
Check number AND street AND unit before you pull a package.
When you find a misload, report it so the load gets fixed, instead of everyone hunting for it twice.
Time lost digging at every stop is time you never get back on the route.
